info.name: SnapAPI - Screenshot & Web Data Analyze Dashboard API

description.content:
Professional screenshot, PDF, video, scraping, content extraction, and AI analysis API. Convert any URL into structured data or visual captures with a single API call. Powered by headless Chromium.

## Authentication

All API endpoints (except Auth and Health) require one of:
- `X-Api-Key: sk_live_xxx` header (recommended for server-side)
- `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx` header
- `?access_key=sk_live_xxx` query parameter (for GET endpoints)

Dashboard endpoints use JWT Bearer tokens obtained from `/auth/login`.

## Rate Limits

| Plan | Requests/month | Rate |
|------|---------------|------|
| Free | 100 | 10/min |
| Starter | 5,000 | 60/min |
| Pro | 50,000 | 300/min |

Rate limit headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`
